# ArchSim

> A free, client-only system design simulator. Build an architecture from 29 cloud components, then watch traffic, latency, failures and monthly cost react live. Includes 18 interview problems with reference solutions.

ArchSim runs entirely in the browser. A design is a JSON document; a share link is that JSON compressed with lz-string after `#g=`.

## Docs

- [Design format](https://github.com/UsmanQasim/Archsim/blob/main/docs/FORMAT.md): the JSON schema for designs and share links
- [How the simulation works](https://github.com/UsmanQasim/Archsim/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the traffic, latency, failure and cost model
- [Where the numbers come from](https://github.com/UsmanQasim/Archsim/blob/main/docs/NUMBERS.md): sources for latency and price assumptions
